title: aia-prefill-canada: a reproducible corpus of Canada's published Algorithmic Impact Assessments, score reproduction and a pre-specified evaluation protocol
description: Licences: code MIT; report, crosswalk and docs CC BY 4.0; derived AIA tables contain information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada; questionnaire MIT (c) 2019 Government of Canada (see NOTICE.md). Code, derived data and technical report. Builds a corpus of the 39 Algorithmic Impact Assessments published on open.canada.ca, reproduces the official tool's raw score and impact level for 31 of 32 machine-readable assessments with version-aware scoring, tests model inputs for level leakage, maps the AIA questionnaire to NIST AI RMF 1.0 and OMB M-25-21, and pre-specifies an evaluation protocol for assisted pre-filling. No model results are reported. Only derived tables are redistributed; source files are re-downloaded from the Government of Canada under the Open Government Licence - Canada.
notes: No model has been trained or evaluated, and no accuracy is reported. The evaluation protocol (docs/eval-plan.md, docs/lockbox.sha256) was frozen on 2026-11-05, before any model output existed.
